invariants.rationale: The TableMetaClient argument should not be null to operate on a table's metadata.
The list of columns to index should not be null in the method contract.
The parameter columnsToIndex should always be a List.
The parameter metaClient should always be an instance of HoodieTableMetaClient as per method signature.
The List columnsToIndex should either be empty or contain Strings due to the declared type List<String>.
